Resolves #19139

Legend icons were written as HTML into a text vnode, so the browser rendered no icon. The icon now uses a native `i` vnode with reactive classes. Five browser tests cover the default/custom icon, removal and restoration, and initial/updated text.

Evidence: L3 (local Chromium DOM witnesses) → L3 required (the five rendered rows). No post-merge-only residual.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/component/component/Legend.spec.mjs` follows the Image/Base viewport setup and awaits destruction. |
| AC-2 | Five tests, one per table row; icon classes and text are also changed after creation. |
| AC-3 | After [the failing receipt](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19139#issuecomment-6679314447), the author incorporated the native-icon restoration into the ticket before source edits. `useIcon` and the text vnode retain their contracts. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered by the component tier; the focused local browser run passed all five rows. |
| AC-5 | `npm run test-components`: 543 passed in 6.4 minutes at rebased head `7084d52cfc`; the hosted component tier covers the complete suite. |

## Deltas from ticket

The original test-only scope exposed the absent icon. The ticket author incorporated the narrow restoration. The text-change row also clears text while preserving the icon, and the custom-icon row verifies a later class update.

## Test Evidence

Outside-CI negative control on the base source: four browser cases failed because no icon element existed; initial text passed. The captured DOM contained two text-node ranges. After the three-line production repair, all five cases passed. The existing Fieldset legend regression also passed both cases.

The first full run exposed a missing generated Mermaid bundle and one Splitter error. After `npm run bundle-mermaid`, both affected files passed on unchanged base production source (13 cases). Restoring the Legend candidate and repeating the full suite passed all 530; the Splitter error did not recur in either follow-up run.

Change class: restoration. `agent-preflight`: not hosted here (`Missing script`); PR baseline jobs provide the hosted checks.

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained. It is a three-line rendering restoration at the exact sites the ticket prescribes, plus one browser spec; it teaches no new architectural concept.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The claim is that the Legend icon never rendered because `afterSetIconCls()` wrote `<i>` markup into a text vnode. The fix makes `cn[0]` a native `i` node whose classes are set reactively. I checked this against head `7084d52cfc`:
- The diff touches only the sites #19139's AC-3 names: `cn[0]` becomes `{tag: 'i'}`, and `afterSetIconCls()` sets `cls`. `afterSetUseIcon()`'s `removeDom` and the text node at `cn[1]` are unchanged.
- `text_` is reactive in `component.Base`, so the `afterSetText()` rows are real.
- The one risk I looked for was a class-array entry containing spaces (`'far fa-check'`) breaking the class delta on a post-mount update. It does not: the "renders the configured icon classes" row switches `fa fa-star` to `far fa-check` after mount in the browser tier.
- The negative control (four rows red on base source) is in the body. Exact-head CI is green (43 success, 1 skipped).
